definitions.DISTINCT_BINDING_DIVERSITY: More than one frozen callable identity is selected and no selected pair shares one callable identity with different bindings.
definitions.LINEAGE_SOURCE_INCONSISTENT: At least one selected Strategy ID is absent from the combined frozen lineage, has the wrong frozen game identity, or source switch metadata cannot be reconciled with selected identities.
definitions.MIXED_DIVERSITY: The selected set contains both a same-callable/different-binding pair and more than one frozen callable identity.
definitions.NO_SWITCH: The source switch count is zero or all selected Strategy IDs collapse to one frozen binding identity; raw Strategy-ID switch count remains reported separately.
definitions.PARAMETER_SIBLING_DIVERSITY_ONLY: More than one binding is selected, every resolved selection remains in one frozen callable family, and a same-callable/different-binding pair is present.
definitions.distinct_binding_boolean: more_than_one_distinct_binding_identity_selected is true exactly when more than one frozen callable identity is selected.
definitions.transition_boundary: Classes describe the set and frequencies of selected identities; they do not assert an unobserved transition order.
